text:
ops-bot: Canary live: Dedicated L90T + H300S are deployed in sa-east-2 (buenos-aires-bue-1). Limited canary for 72h, reservations for new accounts paused for 14 days. :argentina:

marcos-prod: L90T is our next-gen L-series tuned for int8 mixed workloads. Bench quicknote: ~18-22% token cost reduction vs A100X on 6-8k contexts. H300S aimed at low-p95 latency workloads.

olivia-sre: Infra: initial footprint = 6 racks. Health gates: nvlink error rate <0.15% and no increase in kernel OOMs. We'll run a livepatch at 02:00-02:20 UTC (non-disruptive). Dashboards are live under infra/canary/bue.

sam-sales: Please prepare embargoed customer messaging and temporary pricing for LATAM. We need a one-pager for strategic accounts.

kevin-support: Support note: tag tickets with "bue-l90t" and collect model id, seq len, and route if customers report regressions. Escalate to #eng-runtime for nvlink or OOMs.

ops-bot: Reservation exceptions require the capacity form: https://redwood.company/capacity-request. Include customer id, expected QPS, and preferred start. Reactions: :rocket:
